methods.name: get_accelerate
methods.summary: Returns whether this configuration has enabled simple state acceleration.

methods.summary: Returns whether this configuration has enabled byte classes or not. This is typically a debugging oriented option, as disabling it confers no speed benefit.

methods.summary: Returns the match semantics set in this configuration.

methods.name: get_minimize
methods.summary: Returns whether this configuration has enabled the expensive process of minimizing a DFA.

methods.name: get_prefilter
methods.summary: Returns the prefilter attached to this configuration, if any.

methods.name: get_quit
methods.summary: Returns whether this configuration will instruct the DFA to enter a quit state whenever the given byte is seen during a search. When at least one byte has this enabled, it is possible for a search to return an error.

methods.summary: Returns whether this configuration has enabled anchored starting states for every pattern in the DFA.

methods.name: get_unicode_word_boundary
methods.summary: Returns whether this configuration has enabled heuristic Unicode word boundary support. When enabled, it is possible for a search to return an error.

items.name: DFA
items.summary: A dense table-based deterministic finite automaton (DFA).

methods.name: alphabet_len
methods.summary: Returns the total number of elements in the alphabet for this DFA.

methods.name: always_match
methods.summary: Create a new DFA that matches every input.

methods.name: as_ref
methods.summary: Cheaply return a borrowed version of this dense DFA. Specifically, the DFA returned always uses `&[u32]` for its transition table.

methods.summary: Create a new dense DFA builder with the default configuration.

methods.summary: Returns the equivalence classes that make up the alphabet for this DFA.

methods.name: config
methods.summary: Return a new default dense DFA compiler configuration.

methods.name: from_bytes
methods.summary: Safely deserialize a DFA with a specific state identifier representation. Upon success, this returns both the deserialized DFA and the number of bytes read from the given slice. Namely, the contents of the slice beyond the DFA are not read.

methods.summary: Returns true only if this DFA has starting states for each pattern.

methods.name: stride
methods.summary: Returns the total stride for every state in this DFA. This corresponds to the total number of transitions used by each state in this DFA's transition table.

methods.name: to_bytes_big_endian
methods.summary: Serialize this DFA as raw bytes to a `Vec<u8>` in big endian format. Upon success, the `Vec<u8>` and the initial padding length are returned.

methods.name: to_bytes_little_endian
methods.summary: Serialize this DFA as raw bytes to a `Vec<u8>` in little endian format. Upon success, the `Vec<u8>` and the initial padding length are returned.

methods.name: to_bytes_native_endian
methods.summary: Serialize this DFA as raw bytes to a `Vec<u8>` in native endian format. Upon success, the `Vec<u8>` and the initial padding length are returned.

methods.name: to_owned
methods.summary: Return an owned version of this sparse DFA. Specifically, the DFA returned always uses `Vec<u32>` for its transition table.

methods.name: to_sparse
methods.summary: Convert this dense DFA to a sparse DFA.

methods.name: write_to_big_endian
methods.summary: Serialize this DFA as raw bytes to the given slice, in big endian format. Upon success, the total number of bytes written to `dst` is returned.

methods.name: write_to_len
methods.summary: Return the total number of bytes required to serialize this DFA.

methods.name: write_to_little_endian
methods.summary: Serialize this DFA as raw bytes to the given slice, in little endian format. Upon success, the total number of bytes written to `dst` is returned.

methods.name: write_to_native_endian
methods.summary: Serialize this DFA as raw bytes to the given slice, in native endian format. Upon success, the total number of bytes written to `dst` is returned.
